    {"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":26,"why":"Patient described swelling starting 'just in the corner sort of on the left first' and 'still feel it like, really pumping blood and it's kinda getting bigger it feels like it's getting worse' indicating it has been for the past 1 hour."},
    {"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":36,"why":"Patient stated 'must have been like, must have been like, I don't know half an hour maybe' indicating the swelling started after half an hour."},
    {"i":2,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient did not report chest tightness or difficulty breathing at the time of the consultation. She only mentioned feeling like she couldn't breathe well and her chest feeling tight after the swelling started."},
    {"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":33,"why":"Doctor observed 'swelling of your lips' and 'throat is closing up, any feeling like that?' and patient confirmed 'Yeah actually, I, I feel like I can't breathe that well right now.'"},
    {"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":61,"why":"Patient mentioned 'I generally have asthma' and 'I do take that regularly but I've always taken it.'"},
    {"i":5,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient only mentioned having a peanut allergy and not having had an injection for it as a child. She also stated 'I've changed doctors since.'"},
    {"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":62,"why":"Patient confirmed 'Ohh I, no I don't think so, no.' indicating she does not use any other inhalers besides Salbutamol."},
    {"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":88,"why":"Doctor advised 'Could you ask the person whether they have any antihistamines around, in the interim, while we're waiting.'"},
    {"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":90,"why":"Doctor advised 'Mum, if you can call. Mum, if you can call the 999, and say that your there is a suspected anaphylactic reaction and they need to come straight away.'"},
    {"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":94,"why":"Doctor advised 'after you come out from the hospital do give us a ring back we might need to sort you out, um, with your injections and things like that OK?'"}
